title: The Scariest Song
contentHtml:
Happy Halloween! A few days ago, I recalled how The Beatles “Eleanor Rigby” scared me as a child. No, the song doesn’t continue to give me a fright, but it remains an eerie masterpiece.

This naturally got me thinking about songs that still scare me. I put together a preliminary list and then turned to social media to see what I missed. Paid subscribers can see the playlist below. I challenge you to listen to all of these songs without being creeped out.
